QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global set to 0 in `library/constant_time.c`. The compiler cannot prove that value, so it cannot specialise on the input.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque and its role. It puts the function in the plain-C fallback and the volatile global in constant_time.c, but it never locates the function in library/constant_time_impl.h. The only mention of that file is a general statement that all primitives live there.
